obligations.note: The new payment-advice entry in controls/payments/asset-inventory.json has an empty owner ("owner": ""), so this integration is not inventoried with an owner. CI confirms it: test_integrations_are_inventoried failed with ('payment-advice', 'no owner'), and test_inventory_entries_have_owner_and_classification also failed.

The closed integrations list in integrations.py has four entries at head, all with https base URLs, including the new https://advice.fernbrook.example/v1. transports.py is unchanged, and test_integrations_use_tls is reported passing.
No exception in the register is scoped to INV-1 or to payments.integrations, so the missing-owner deviation is not excused.
Ticket CHG-25317 is standard and approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-26, before review. Its components (payments.controls-data, payments.integrations) cover both touched paths.
Mara Costa, a change_approver for payments and not the author Jonah Weiss under any of his addresses, approved code_review on the head commit.
All approvals name the single head commit 8414e2b9, and there are no later commits.

The CI run on the head commit has result 'failure', with 2 failing tests, including the registered INV-1 control test. The JUnit report is also timestamped 2026-10-23 on host dev-laptop-7.local, which does not match the ci-runner-06 run on 2026-10-28.
The payments.integrations component is security_sensitive. Ines Halvorsen (security_reviewer) gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
controls/payments/asset-inventory.json is a protected path. Bao Tran (control_owner, controls-office team, outside the author's payments-eng team) approved control_owner on the head commit.
The ledger entries cover payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and mortgage files, none of which this change touches, so no accepted evidence lapses.

summary: The change registers a new HTTPS integration, but its inventory entry has an empty owner, which violates INV-1; no exception covers this. The change's own CI run on the head commit failed, including the registered INV-1 control test, and the JUnit report's timestamp and host do not match that run. Ticket, independent code review, security review and control-owner approvals are all in order. Because INV-1 and CHG-4 are violated, the change is rejected.
